0:
# 初始化指标文件
touch /tmp/metrics.txt

# 后台进程：定期更新指标
while true; do
  {
    echo "# HELP smb_mount_healthy SMB 挂载点是否健康 (1=健康, 0=不健康)"
    echo "# TYPE smb_mount_healthy gauge"

    for mount_info in \
      "sakamoto_media:/mnt/sakamoto-media" \
      "backup_media:/mnt/backup-media"
    do
      name="$${mount_info%%:*}"
      path="$${mount_info#*:}"

      if timeout 5 ls "$path" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "smb_mount_healthy{name=\"$name\",path=\"$path\",node=\"$NODE_NAME\"} 1"
      else
        echo "smb_mount_healthy{name=\"$name\",path=\"$path\",node=\"$NODE_NAME\"} 0"
      fi
    done
  } > /tmp/metrics.txt.new && mv /tmp/metrics.txt.new /tmp/metrics.txt

  sleep 30
done &

# HTTP 服务器提供指标 (前台运行 httpd)
httpd -f -p 9101 -h /tmp

update_ip() {
  local ip=$(wget -qO- https://6.ipw.cn 2>/dev/null)
  if [ -z "$ip" ]; then
    echo "[ip-selector] Failed to detect IP, keeping previous"
    return 1
  elif echo "$ip" | grep -q "^2408:"; then
    echo "$ip" > /tmp/current-ip
    echo "[ip-selector] Using unicom IP: $ip"
  else
    echo "$MAIN_VPS_IP_V6" > /tmp/current-ip
    echo "[ip-selector] Using VPS IP (non-2408 detected: $ip)"
  fi
}

# 初始化（带重试）
for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do
  update_ip && break
  echo "[ip-selector] Retry $i/5..."
  sleep 5
done

# 后台定时更新
while true; do sleep 270; update_ip; done &

# HTTP 服务
while true; do
  { echo -e "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\n\r\n$(cat /tmp/current-ip 2>/dev/null)"; } | nc -l -p 8888 >/dev/null
done

metrics:
  suggestion:
    - name: random
      image: ghcr.io/kubeflow/katib/suggestion-hyperopt
      tag: v0.17.0
    - name: tpe
      image: ghcr.io/kubeflow/katib/suggestion-hyperopt
      tag: v0.17.0
  early-stopping:
    - name: median-stop
      image: ghcr.io/kubeflow/katib/earlystopping-medianstop
      tag: v0.17.0

# Minimal Envoy config for MLMD
static_resources:
  listeners:
  - name: listener_0
    address:
      socket_address: { address: 0.0.0.0, port_value: 9090 }
    filter_chains:
    - filters:
      - name: envoy.filters.network.http_connection_manager
        typed_config:
          "@type": type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.network.http_connection_manager.v3.HttpConnectionManager
          codec_type: auto
          stat_prefix: ingress_http
          route_config:
            name: local_route
            virtual_hosts:
            - name: local_service
              domains: ["*"]
              routes:
              - match: { prefix: "/" }
                route: { cluster: metadata_service }
          http_filters:
          - name: envoy.filters.http.router
            typed_config:
              "@type": type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.http.router.v3.Router
  clusters:
  - name: metadata_service
    connect_timeout: 0.25s
    type: logical_dns
    lb_policy: round_robin
    load_assignment:
      cluster_name: metadata_service
      endpoints:
      - lb_endpoints:
        - endpoint:
            address:
              socket_address:
                address: metadata-grpc.kubeflow.svc.cluster.local
                port_value: 8080

spawnerFormDefaults:
  image:
    value: kubeflownotebookswg/jupyter-scipy:v1.10.0
    options:
      - kubeflownotebookswg/jupyter-scipy:v1.10.0
      - kubeflownotebookswg/jupyter-pytorch-full:v1.10.0
      - kubeflownotebookswg/jupyter-tensorflow-full:v1.10.0
  allowCustomImage: true
  imagePullPolicy:
    value: IfNotPresent
    readOnly: false
  cpu:
    value: "0.5"
    readOnly: false
  memory:
    value: "1.0Gi"
    readOnly: false
  workspaceVolume:
    readOnly: true
    value:
      mount: /home/jovyan
      newPvc:
        spec:
          resources:
            requests:
              storage: 10Gi
          accessModes:
            - ReadWriteOnce
  affinityConfig:
    readOnly: true
    options:
        displayName: "GCP (Liqo)"
        affinity:
          nodeAffinity:
            requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
              nodeSelectorTerms:
                - matchExpressions:
                      operator: "In"
                      values:
                        - "virtual-node"
  tolerationGroup:
    readOnly: true
    options:
        displayName: "GCP (Liqo)"
        tolerations:
            operator: "Exists"
            effect: "NoExecute"
  shm:
    value: true
    readOnly: false
  configurations:
    value: []
    readOnly: false

# Defines the labels to be added to the namespace created by the profile controller.
# The key is the label name and the value is the label value.
# If the value is empty, the label is not added.
# If the value is not empty, the label is added.
app.kubernetes.io/part-of: kubeflow-profile
